_README: Hand-recorded annotations that tools/build_recipe_index.py cannot derive. Everything else in
.index/recipes.tsv and .index/features.tsv is generated -- do not hand-edit those.
build_recipe_index.py EXITS NON-ZERO if a gated recipe is missing from `recipes` below, so a
newly added gate cannot reach Phase 3 unclassified.

_class_meaning.1: Pure NULL-fill. Widening the seed gate only ADDS rows; every existing value is unchanged, because the recipe's normalisers are global (whole-graph COUNT{} or a per-disease loop over a global adjacency). Safe to widen: the pre-change population stays a clean control.
_class_meaning.2: Recomputes an aggregate over the ELIGIBLE set. Widening the gate CHANGES existing rows -- a different intervention, not a NULL fill. Widening this together with Class 1 recipes confounds two interventions in one rebuild.

_champion_features_provenance: m7-f14, saved model hJLGoYn4. RECONSTRUCTED, not read directly -- read the warning below.
TRAP: `dku ml settings I2csfIX2 krJwswcb` returns the CURRENT state of the mltask, NOT the
config of any deployed model version. m8-f14-pm was trained in that same mltask by swapping
prox_kernel -> prox_mean, so the task now reports prox_mean as INPUT and prox_kernel as
REJECTED. The feature COUNT still reads 14, which matches the name m7-f14 and makes the wrong
list look correct. Do not source champion features from `ml settings` without checking which
This list is that output with prox_mean -> prox_kernel, per the documented m7 decision
- exactly 7 of these 14 carry `module_size >= 20`, matching the documented
'seven of the twelve champion features' (dwpc_GBGD, dwpc_GFGD, dwpc_GGD, dwpc_GPGD,
- m8 is documented as m7 with exactly this one feature swapped, which is self-consistent
NOTE: dwpc_GCD is REJECTED as a model feature. It is a POOL ROUTE only -- it decides which
rows exist (filter_has_path_evidence) but the model never sees it. Section 5.2.1's selection
bias is therefore about evaluability, not about a feature the model reads.

compute_enriched_dwpc_GGD.note: POOL ROUTE. Degrees come from whole-graph COUNT{} subqueries; module_size is per-disease with LOO. Verified in dss_recipes/cypher/.

compute_enriched_dwpc_GPGD.note: POOL ROUTE. Same structure as GGD, pathway-mediated middle node.

compute_enriched_dwpc_GCD.note: POOL ROUTE, compound-mediated. Not a model feature -- pool membership only (see _champion_features_provenance). Source of the 5.2.1 selection bias.

compute_enriched_guilt_by_association_1.note: deg_m and ppi_deg_g are whole-graph COUNT{} over protein_protein, halved for the both-directions Kuzu build. Emits ppi_adamic_adar, ppi_jaccard.

compute_enriched_shared_pathway_count_1.note: n_pathways_g is a whole-graph COUNT{} over pathway_protein, so the frac denominator does not move with eligibility.

compute_enriched_disease_context_1.note: Settled 2026-08-21 from the newly mirrored Cypher. The gate filters the ANCHOR D only; D2 is matched fresh via (D)-[:disease_disease]-(D2) with NO module_size filter, so an existing (g,D) pair's disease_context cannot change. Was flagged unresolved before the mirror existed.

compute_enriched_module_size_1.note: Trivially per-disease. WARNING: this dataset is itself gated, so its minimum IS 20 -- it cannot be used to size the sub-20 population. Use graph_edges disease_protein directly (FEATURE_AUDIT section 5).

compute_enriched_rwr_score_1.note: MIN_SEEDS gate inside a per-disease loop; adjacency and degrees are global. Was UNVERSIONED until 2026-08-21 -- a gated recipe with no diff history.

compute_enriched_prox_closest.note: Per-disease BFS. Phase 1 already lowered MIN_SEEDS to 5 and capped with POOL_MIN=20 so the population would not move; Phase 3 lowers POOL_MIN. Emits prox_closest, prox_mean, prox_kernel, prox_n_reach.

compute_dwpc_go_metapaths.note: THE ONLY CLASS 2. `assoc` (per-gene disease degree) is computed over the ELIGIBLE disease set and feeds the DWPC weight, so widening eligibility changes dwpc_GBGD/dwpc_GFGD for EXISTING pairs. A 20->5 change was applied and REVERTED on 2026-08-20 for this reason. Phase 3 HOLDS this at 20 to keep the pre-change population byte-identical.

_entry_points_README: Files invoked from OUTSIDE the repo, so nothing here references them. Without this list the code
index reports them as orphaned: webapp/backend.py is served by a DSS webapp, not called by repo
code. 'Unreferenced' and 'unused' are not the same thing.
